fields.Name: C1 -> C3.3
fields.Description: Gate G7.8 (owner PR 1, phase 7, dataset C1, criterion C3.3): a prompt configured at temperature 0 reaches the Gemini, Vertex and Bedrock clients as 0, 3 of 3 (0.5, 0.5 and 0.7 today), and a rejected parameter raises instead of being replaced. Captures the real request bodies without network (Gemini and Vertex at fetch, Bedrock at an SDK middleware); a strict call whose seed Bedrock drops, and a strict temperature-0 call to a Gemini model that no longer takes temperature (3.6 and later), each raise ParameterFidelityError before any request; no model calls, no database writes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Temperature 0 is sent as 0 by Gemini, Vertex and Bedrock (3 of 3); a strict call Bedrock would send without its seed, and a strict temperature-0 call to gemini-3.8-flash, raise ParameterFidelityError with no request sent.
